title: AML Add request
description: Request body for POST /add as implemented by benchmark/aml-local/serve.py. One Add carries one conversation session for one isolated user.

request_id.description: Platform-unique id for this Add call. Drives idempotency: the OpenContext messageId is derived as `aml:<request_id>:<index>`, so retries of the same request_id never duplicate memories.

user_id.description: Isolation scope. Passed through verbatim as the OpenContext userId; every eval sample stays isolated.

role.description: Speaker role, e.g. "user" or "assistant". Defaults to "user" when omitted.

content.description: Message payload; non-string values are stringified before storage.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch milliseconds. Defaults to the adapter receive time when omitted.
